correctness.rationale: Hyperplane incidence W={(p_i,H):H(p_i)=0} has pure dimension D=M+n(d−1), irreducible by Bertini for d≥2 and constant-dimensional fibers. Its rank-M projection is an isomorphism by local maximal minors. The preimage of rank<M is a proper closed subset and fibers have dimension at least one, hence rank-drop image codimension≥2. Tangent hyperplane-point incidence has dimension M−1; adding n−1 section points bounds singular locus on rank-M by D−d, d≥2. Published prime/CM gives S2, incidence tangent analysis gives R1, so normality follows by Serre. This is multiprojective, not the multicone; finite checker only tests dimension and witness construction.
